title: Ethecore
description: Adds an animation and model system, as well as other utilities.
body:
Ethecore is a core library designed for the Etheria mod and future projects.
It features:
- Loading and implementation of Geo-models and Bedrock animations.
- NBT tag (de)serialization utilities for capabilities and more.

The source code is currently private and is subject to frequent changes until the project leaves Beta.
